page.layout: One printed page, two columns of an index, with a running head "INDEX." centred above. Left column first, then right column. No margin notes on the printed page itself; the right edge shows show-through from the facing page, which is left out.

page.notes: Several entries are partly illegible or rendered with broken type, notably "somnia non sit occisus" (the last line of the left column is smudged), "ein Lutherisscher" (black letter, possibly German), and "Lemnia terra 5." Some readings (e.g. "quo-ua", "cōficienda") are doubtful. The leftmost "randa 97" is a fragment continued from the previous page. The "&" marks are kept as printed.
